data.narrative:
Wisk Aero is a Series C-stage aerospace company that has raised $450M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 6 private peers in Space & Aerospace at Series B through Series D stages, including Sierra Space ($8.0B), Apex Space ($2.3B), Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B), Varda Space Industries ($1.6B), Aalyria ($1.3B), and one additional peer. Public comparables in the sector (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) trade at a median P/S of 27.4x but cannot anchor this analysis absent disclosed revenue.

Two valuation methods prove applicable. Stage-progression methodology applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the $450M total-raised baseline, implying a valuation of $765M. Peer-median analysis across the six same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $1.8B, with a range from $1.15B to $8.0B. The dispersion reflects material heterogeneity in business model maturity and capital requirements within the cohort.

These methods triangulate to a valuation range of $650M to $2.1B, with a median implied value of $1.3B. Key uncertainties include the company's specific revenue traction, path to cash generation, and technical differentiation relative to better-capitalized peers like Sierra Space. The wide peer range ($1.15B–$8.0B) underscores stage-dependent valuation sensitivity in frontier aerospace.
